product_metadata.title: WBHome 5FT Decorated Artificial Christmas Tree with Ornaments and Lights, Rose Gold Christmas Decorations Including 5 Feet Full Tree, Ornaments Set, 200 LED Lights

[Save Money and time] We've brought you this delicated-design tree package with numerous kinds decorations, which may cost you hours for shopping similar set with twice or even triple price. Save your time and money for a better holiday!

Sturdy metal base provides stability, prevents breakage, and keeps your tree standing tall. Basic assembly required

[200 LEDs USB String Light] This 5ft Christmas tree features a 200 long-life LED string lights. These high-quality lights shine bright while also being low on energy consumption. Also, the insulated copper wire keeps the lights at a low temperature so they are safe to touch after many hours of use.

[Efficient Customer Service] We are a company dedicated to bringing customers holiday decoration solutions and a variety of holiday decoration products. We focus on the customer's experience. If you have any questions about the product after opening the package, please contact us, we will arrange the customer service team to solve the problem for you as soon as possible.
